IOCL Executive Online Form 2025 - Complete Details

Short Information : Indian Oil Corporation of India (IOCL) has released the notification for the post of Executive. This recruitment has been issued for 108 posts. Online applying process for IOCL Executive Recruitment 2025 has started from 10 January 2025 & the candidates can apply till 24 January 2025. Candidates must check the complete details for IOCL Executive Recruitment 2025 which has given below.

Important Dates

  • Notification Date : 10 January 2025
  • Application Start Date : 10 January 2025
  • Last Date : 24 January 2025
  • Fee Payment Last Date : 24 January 2025
  • Exam Date : 23 February 2025 (Tentative)
  • Admit Card : Before Exam

Application Fee

  • General, EWS, OBC : Rs. 1000/-
  • SC, ST, PH : 0/-
  • Candidates have to pay their Examination Fee Through Debit Card / Credit Card / Net Banking / UPI and Other Fee Payment Mode Only.

How to Apply Online

  1. Visit the official website.
  2. Click on the online application / registration link.
  3. Register with your basic details like name, email, mobile number.
  4. Fill the application form with personal, educational and address details.
  5. Upload scanned photograph, signature and required documents.
  6. Pay the application fee online.
  7. Submit the form and take a printout for future reference.

Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)

What is IOCL Executive Online Form 2025?

IOCL Executive Online Form 2025 is a government exam related notification. Complete details including important dates, fee, eligibility and links are provided above.

What is the last date to apply?

The last date to apply is 24 January 2025.

Where can I find the official website?

The official website is: https://iocl.com/latest-job-opening

How to download notification?

Click on the relevant link in the Important Links section above or visit the official website directly.
